Dear colleagues,

NHC has issued their cyclone forecasts for Jul. 2, 2pm (NY time). There is 1 active storm: Beryl.

This email consolidates exposure estimates from OCHA CHD. Estimates from ADAM and GDACS were not accessed for this email.

Best regards,
OCHA Centre for Humanitarian Data
